subject: Aligning MAP: SOC 2 / SIG / DPA evidence parity and close timeline
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearbridge.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Clara Ruiz <legal@clearbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Aligning MAP: SOC 2 / SIG / DPA evidence parity and close timeline

Hi Samir / Clara —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. Per our mutual action plan, I want to lock the acceptance criteria and evidence handoff path so we can hit your target close window (end of December). High level asks:

- Confirm which SOC 2 controls you need evidence for vs which you accept via our Type II report. We have a small set of operational artifacts that teams ask for routinely (access lists, change control runbook excerpts, periodic backup snapshots).
- SIG / CAIQ: we can accelerate and return the spreadsheet with narrative for any "not applicable" items by next Wed if that's helpful.
- DPA: Clara, I attached our latest DPA redline (DPA-redline-v2.docx). Can you confirm whether the SLC/data retention clause in section 6 is acceptable or whether you need modification for 7-year retention carveouts?

I've attached an evidence inventory (SOC2-Evidence-Inventory.pdf) that maps doc owners and expected delivery dates. Proposed cadence: evidence intake sprint the week of Nov 29, internal review Dec 6-8, final sign-off Dec 20, and DocuSign by Dec 22 so your procurement can process for a Dec 31 go-live.

If that timeline is too aggressive on your side, propose alternate dates and we'll adapt the MAP.

Thanks — Naomi

Naomi Feldman
Head of Security & Trust, Redwood Inference
aomi@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0147

Attachments: SOC2-Evidence-Inventory.pdf (list), DPA-redline-v2.docx (redline)

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearbridge.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Clara Ruiz <legal@clearbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning MAP: SOC 2 / SIG / DPA evidence parity and close timeline

Naomi —

Appreciate the breakdown. Quick answers:

- SOC 2: Procurement will accept the Type II attestation for several control areas, but we will need live artifacts for change control (evidence of recent change tickets), logical access lists (last 90 days), and backup/restore runbook excerpt + test log.
- SIG: The spreadsheet you suggested is perfect. If you can flag the critical 40 questions we care about, we will review those first.
- DPA: Our legal team is okay with a 3-year standard retention, but we have a small carveout for regulatory data up to 7 years. Clara will push any redline comments in a separate note.

Timeline: Dec 20 sign-off is tight but doable. Two asks to make it realistic: 1) start the evidence intake week of Nov 29 as you noted, 2) we need an intermediate checkpoint Dec 10 to validate any outstanding items before execs review.

I'll loop in our procurement lead if we get to final DPA.

Thanks — Samir

Samir Patel
Director, Platform Risk — ClearBridge Finance
samir.patel@clearbridge.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearbridge.com>

Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning MAP: SOC 2 / SIG / DPA evidence parity and close timeline

On Thu, Nov 19, 2026 at 09:12 Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Samir / Clara —
> 
> Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. Per our mutual action plan...

Samir / team —

We've run a quick internal pass on the inventory and pulled owners for the three SOC 2 artifacts you called out:

- Change control tickets: Owner = Infra Ops (Ethan), ETA = 2026-11-30 (we will sanitize ticket IDs and include screenshots).
- Logical access lists: Owner = IAM (Priya), ETA = 2026-12-01 (CSV export + explanation).
- Backup/restore runbook + latest test log: Owner = SRE (Mateo), ETA = 2026-12-03 (redacted logs + test result).

SIG: Kimberly will lead the CAIQ narrative for the top 40 flagged questions and return the spreadsheet by Dec 2 so you have a week for internal review before the Dec 10 checkpoint.

DPA: Naomi / Clara — we captured Samir's carveout note for regulatory data (7 years). Kimberly, can you reconcile retention language with our KMS/key-rotation schedule and the proposed 3-year default? I put a draft comment inside DPA-redline-v2.docx.

We'll attach the initial evidence batch to the shared Drive folder today (link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-clearbridge-evidence). Please confirm access.

-Jordan

Jordan Blake
Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearbridge.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Clara Ruiz <legal@clearbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning MAP: SOC 2 / SIG / DPA evidence parity and close timeline

Thanks all — quick MAP summary and immediate asks (so nothing falls through the cracks):

1) Evidence intake week of Nov 29: Jordan to upload initial artifacts (change tickets, IAM export, runbook + test logs) by 11/30. Samir please confirm access and whether the redaction level is acceptable.
2) CAIQ: Kimberly to deliver CAIQ narrative for top-40 by 12/02. Samir to flag any priority follow-ups by 12/06.
3) Checkpoint call: Dec 10 @ 10am PT — confirm calendar invite for decision review ahead of executive sign-off.
4) DPA path: Clara to return redline comments by 12/03 and confirm whether 7-year carveout is acceptable; if not, propose specific language.
5) Acceptance: internal review 12/06-12/08; exec review 12/15-12/18; sign-off target 12/20 and DocuSign by 12/22.

If ClearBridge needs a softer close, propose an alternative mid-Jan window and we will update the MAP. Otherwise we will proceed to the intake sprint and keep the checkpoint cadence above.

Naomi

Naomi Feldman
Head of Security & Trust, Redwood Inference
aomi@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: SOC2-Evidence-Inventory.pdf, SIG-CAIQ-partial.xlsx, DPA-redline-v2.docx
